title.narrative: Building 1,500 temporary housing units for those affected by the earthquake in Turkey

description.narrative: 1,500 housing units in Turkey, including infrastructure works.

Constructing 1,500 temporary housing units for those affected by the earthquake in Turkey. Each temporary housing unit consists of two rooms and a toilet, carrying out the necessary infrastructure works, providing the housing units with the basic needs of electricity by providing solar energy units, and providing each housing unit with some basic furniture.
Shelter those affected by the earthquake who lost their homes in Turkey in a safe and appropriate shelter that provides them with a decent life.
